visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a crowded urban plaza featuring a massive, ornate Gothic cathedral with a soaring spire. Numerous people in winter coats walk across the cobblestone-like pavement under an overcast sky. (2) A woman with dark hair and a light blue turtleneck appears in a medium close-up, moving her lips while looking at the camera and gesturing slightly; the bustling cathedral square remains blurred in the background. (3) The camera pans across the Christmas market stalls, showing wooden huts decorated with evergreen garlands and warm lights; a man in a tan jacket stands behind a purple-lit counter labeled 'Lost & Found'. (4) Close-up shots highlight specialized retail products including glass jars filled with layered dry ingredients (flour, grains, seeds) and red ceramic mugs featuring an illustration of the cathedral. (5) A woman in a pink puffer jacket and glasses is seen in a medium shot, holding a red mug and pointing her finger upward while smiling; she is surrounded by a crowd in an open street area. (6) The video transitions to indoor displays of miniature illuminated cardboard houses and then returns to outdoor street scenes with hanging festive light fixtures and three elderly men sitting at a table with plates of food.
